content_html:
Lima and Cusco offer completely different experiences.

Many travelers think Peru is only Lima…
but Cusco has a different climate, a different culture, and a completely different way to travel.

LIMA — Coast, gastronomy, and urban life
Located at sea level
World-renowned cuisine
Modern city facing the Pacific Ocean
Perfect for restaurants, culture, and nightlife

CUSCO — Andes, history, and adventure
More than 3,300 meters above sea level
Inca culture and ancestral history
Stunning mountains and landscapes
Gateway to Machu Picchu

Important tip for travelers:
In Cusco, you need time to acclimate to the altitude.

Rest on your first day
Drink plenty of water
Bring clothes for both cold and sunny weather
Allow extra time for tours and transportation

Peru is not just one destination.
It’s coast, mountains, gastronomy, history, and adventure all in one trip.
